thread.title: Smart Home Devices: These Categories Are Growing the Fastest

title: Smart Home Devices: These Categories Are Growing the Fastest
text:
Large Photo: Sonos 
As the market for smart home technology grows over the next five years, home monitoring and lighting devices are expected to see big gains—but smart speakers still have lots of room to run. 
The world-wide smart home device market is expected to grow by a compounded annual rate of 11% between now and 2022, approaching a total value of $280 billion, according to estimates published Thursday by IDC . 
That will be driven largely by 32% annual growth in smart speakers, IDC said. Amazon.com ’s (AMZN) Echo devices have lately dominated sales, with offerings from Alphabet’s (GOOGL) and Apple (AAPL) among the competitors. 
They’ll be followed by 26% growth in lighting and 23% in home monitoring and security. But those three categories’ combined market sizes, at about $33 billion, will still total just a fraction of the largest—though slowest-growing—category, video entertainment. 
That category includes smart televisions and digital media adapters—like, for instance, Roku’s (ROKU) devices—and is seen growing at an annual rate of 9% to more than $200 billion, according to IDC. Illustration: IDC 
“There’s less of a focus on having a central hub and apps as the center of the interface as hardware makers race to create interoperability with smart assistants like Alexa, Siri, or Google Assistant,” said IDC analyst Jitesh Ubrani in a statement. “On the other hand, consumers, while still somewhat hesitant to anthropomorphize smart assistants, are beginning to expect a more natural user interface to the myriad of smart home devices.”
